people.name: Ben-hadad
people.line: King of Aram, besieged Samaria, contemporary of Elisha.

people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick. He was told, “The man of God has come here.”
translations.bsb: Then Elisha came to Damascus while Ben-hadad king of Aram was sick, and the king was told, “The man of God has come here.”
translations.kjv: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, The man of God is come hither.
translations.asv: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, The man of God is come hither.
